mapper.sql:
from sd_download_log l inner join sd_gis_dataset d on l.dataset_id = d.dataset_id left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on l.file_id = f.file_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and d.deleted_at is null and upper(coalesce(l.download_status, 'SUCCESS')) = 'SUCCESS'
and ( lower(d.title) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.provider, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(c.category_name_ko, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(l.download_format, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )
and l.created_at >= #{periodStart}
and upper(replace(coalesce(l.download_format, f.file_extension, ''), '.', '')) = upper(replace(#{fileFormat}, '.', ''))
mapper.select:
select l.download_id as "downloadId", d.dataset_id as "datasetId", d.title as "title", d.provider as "provider", c.category_name_ko as "categoryNameKo", coalesce(l.download_format, upper(replace(f.file_extension, '.', ''))) as "downloadFormat", coalesce(l.download_file_size, f.file_size) as "fileSize", l.created_at as "downloadedAt"
order by d.title asc, l.created_at desc
order by l.created_at desc, l.download_id desc
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.sql:
from sd_dataset_favorite fav inner join sd_gis_dataset d on fav.dataset_id = d.dataset_id left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where fav.user_id = #{userId} and d.deleted_at is null
and ( lower(d.title) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(d.provider, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(coalesce(c.category_name_ko, '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(replace(coalesce(f.file_extension, ''), '.', '')) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )
and fav.created_at >= #{periodStart}
and upper(replace(coalesce(f.file_extension, ''), '.', '')) = upper(replace(#{fileFormat}, '.', ''))
mapper.select:
select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, fav.created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count, true as favorite
order by d.title asc, fav.created_at desc
order by fav.created_at desc
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, max(v.created_at) as created_at, f.file_extension, coalesce(s.view_count, 0) as view_count, coalesce(s.download_count, 0) as download_count from sd_dataset_view_log v inner join sd_gis_dataset d on v.dataset_id = d.dataset_id left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on d.dataset_id = f.dataset_id and f.file_role = 'ORIGINAL' left join sd_dataset_stat s on d.dataset_id = s.dataset_id left join sd_data_category c on d.category_id = c.category_id where v.user_id = #{userId} and d.deleted_at is null group by d.dataset_id, d.title, d.description, d.provider, d.category_id, c.category_name_ko, d.is_public, f.file_extension, s.view_count, s.download_count order by max(v.created_at) desc limit #{limit}

select upper(replace(coalesce(l.download_format, f.file_extension, 'UNKNOWN'), '.', '')) as "format", count(*) as "count" from sd_download_log l left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on l.file_id = f.file_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and upper(coalesce(l.download_status, 'SUCCESS')) = 'SUCCESS' and l.created_at >= #{periodStart} group by upper(replace(coalesce(l.download_format, f.file_extension, 'UNKNOWN'), '.', '')) order by count(*) desc

select d.dataset_id as "datasetId", d.title as "title", l.created_at as "downloadedAt" from sd_download_log l inner join sd_gis_dataset d on l.dataset_id = d.dataset_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and upper(coalesce(l.download_status, 'SUCCESS')) = 'SUCCESS' and d.deleted_at is null order by l.created_at desc, l.download_id desc limit 1

select upper(replace(coalesce(l.download_format, f.file_extension, 'UNKNOWN'), '.', '')) as download_format from sd_download_log l left join sd_gis_dataset_file f on l.file_id = f.file_id where l.user_id = #{userId} and upper(coalesce(l.download_status, 'SUCCESS')) = 'SUCCESS' and l.created_at >= #{periodStart} group by upper(replace(coalesce(l.download_format, f.file_extension, 'UNKNOWN'), '.', '')) order by count(*) desc, download_format asc limit 1
